title: Grothendieck Math Puzzle — live predictions
source_of_truth: Canonical list of theorem signatures predicted by the 8-pass Grothendieck synthesis (Navi 2026-04-21). Each prediction has a name (Lean identifier), a short claim, and a tag. The site page /algebra/ renders live status by grepping the Lean source tree for each name — closed = identifier found as `theorem NAME` or `lemma NAME` in a .lean file. When a prediction closes, its tag can be bumped from EVIDENCE/SPECULATIVE to LANDED in this file (optional — the grep check is authoritative).

LOAD_BEARING.label: load-bearing
LOAD_BEARING.meaning: supported by existing Lean files; theorem already substantially anchored

EVIDENCE.label: evidence
EVIDENCE.meaning: backed by graph computation or empirical spectrum but not yet Lean-proved

SPECULATIVE.label: speculative
SPECULATIVE.meaning: suggestive pattern, requires more data / literature work

LITERATURE_ANCHORED_GAP.label: literature-anchored gap
LITERATURE_ANCHORED_GAP.meaning: standard literature construct (Connes, Kempf) not yet in OmegaTheory Lean source

LANDED.label: landed
LANDED.meaning: theorem now exists in the Lean corpus (auto-detected by grep)
